newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-WINTERBURN OWN GOAL ENDS MANCHESTER'S LOSING RUN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WINTERBURN OWN GOAL ENDS MANCHESTER'S LOSING RUN.

text.p: A messy own goal by Arsenal defender Nigel Winterburn was enough to end Manchester United's run of three premier league defeats as they scrambled to a 1-0 home win on Saturday.
With Newcastle surprisingly held 1-1 at home by West Ham it enabled the champions to close the gap on the leaders to six points.
United's goal came when Nicky Butt hit the ball across a crowded goalmouth and Winterburn succeeded only in chesting the ball into his own net.
Third-placed Wimbledon were held 2-2 at home by lowly Coventry, so Liverpool leap-frogged into second place with a 2-0 win at Leeds.
Newcastle head the table with 28 points with Liverpool two points behind.
Everton went on the rampage at home to Southampton, recent 6-3 conquerers over Manchester United, hitting five in the first 35 minutes and running out 7-1 winners.
Gary Speed hit a hat-trick while Andrei Kanchelskis scored twice.
